purpose: Researchable, manually reproducible capability compositions. Not integrated apps.
score_label: Research evidence coverage, NOT project quality, safety certification, or integration readiness.
bookmark_policy: Client-side only. Repo bookmarks reuse atlas_favorites_v1; recipe bookmarks use atlas_recipe_favorites_v1. Neither is a GitHub Star.
license_policy: No commercial use or deployment without independent review.

recipes.goal_zh: 将原创研究转为可审核短视频
recipes.goal_en: Turn licensed research into a reviewable short video
inputs_zh: 经版权确认的原创脚本与素材清单
合成测试素材或有授权的视频片段
inputs_en: Original script and documented asset rights
outputs_zh: 待人工复核的视频样片
字幕校对表与授权记录
acceptance_zh: 未授权素材不进入发布清单
acceptance_en: Unlicensed assets do not enter the publish queue

steps.label_zh: 选题与来源授权
steps.label_en: Check topic and asset permissions

steps.label_zh: 独立研究脚本与事实复核
steps.label_en: Draft source-linked script and verify claims

steps.label_zh: 视频/字幕/配音制作
steps.label_en: Produce video, subtitles and narration

steps.label_zh: 人工内容审批
steps.label_en: Obtain human editorial approval

steps.label_zh: 官方支持渠道发布及复盘
steps.label_en: Publish via authorized channels and review results

guardrails_zh: 财经内容不提供直接买卖建议
禁止未获授权的声纹克隆
recipes.stop_condition_zh: 发布前必须人工核对内容与授权
recipes.stop_condition_en: Human legal and editorial review required before publication
guardrails_en: Keep original research and identifiable human review
Do not give direct buy/sell recommendations in finance content

recipes.goal_zh: 规划、审批并衡量跨平台原创内容
recipes.goal_en: Plan, review and measure original multi-channel content
inputs_zh: 三条原创内容与平台差异化版本
预设指标与无需真实账户的测试日历
inputs_en: Three original posts tailored to each channel
acceptance_zh: 未经批准的内容不得进入发布状态
不把合成互动当成真实流量
acceptance_en: No unapproved content is marked for publication
Synthetic engagement never presented as real

steps.label_zh: 按各平台撰写原创版本
steps.label_en: Write distinct original copy for each platform

steps.label_zh: 审批内容日历
steps.label_en: Approve the editorial calendar

steps.label_zh: 平台 API 授权验证
steps.label_en: Validate official platform API authorization

steps.label_zh: 排期发布与评论分流
steps.label_en: Schedule publication and triage comments

steps.label_zh: 平台指标与转化复盘
steps.label_en: Review platform metrics and attribution

guardrails_zh: 遵守每个平台 API 和用户协议
原创表达与人工最终审核
recipes.stop_condition_zh: 官方 API 条款及发布审批不可跳过
recipes.stop_condition_en: Platform API rules and editorial approval are mandatory
guardrails_en: Follow each platform's API rules and terms
No fake engagement or spam follows
Require original content and final human approval

recipes.goal_zh: 将用户主动同意留资转为可审计线索
recipes.goal_en: Convert explicit opt-in into auditable lead records
inputs_zh: 合成表单及明确的同意字段
不含个人信息的测试线索
inputs_en: Synthetic form with explicit consent field
Test leads containing no personal information
outputs_zh: 去重后获同意的合成线索表
撤回同意与预约的测试日志
acceptance_zh: 拒绝无同意与重复线索
撤销同意后停止后续处理
acceptance_en: Stop downstream processing after consent withdrawal

steps.label_zh: 原创活动/内容吸引咨询
steps.label_en: Invite voluntary contact through original materials

steps.label_zh: 表单明确告知与同意
steps.label_en: Present clear notice and collect explicit consent

steps.label_zh: 数据校验和 CRM 去重
steps.label_en: Validate input and deduplicate CRM records

steps.label_zh: 按自报需求进行分层
steps.label_en: Categorize stated user needs

steps.label_zh: 用户主动预约或人工沟通
steps.label_en: Offer user-initiated booking or human contact

guardrails_zh: 禁止未经授权的批量自动私信
记录营销同意和可撤销机制
recipes.stop_condition_zh: 严禁抓取真实个人信息或自动私信
recipes.stop_condition_en: No scraping real personal data or unsolicited mass messaging

recipes.goal_zh: 将客户问题整理为可审核服务流程
outputs_zh: 人工复核和退订审计清单
outputs_en: Human review and opt-out audit checklist
acceptance_zh: 测试租户不能看到另一租户记录
撤销订阅不得再发送提醒
acceptance_en: Synthetic tenants cannot see each other's records

steps.label_zh: 权限隔离的 CRM 资料
steps.label_en: Scope tenant access to CRM data

steps.label_zh: 客户问题受理与分类
steps.label_en: Accept and classify service requests

steps.label_zh: 知识库建议与人工复核
steps.label_en: Propose answers with human verification

steps.label_zh: 经同意的提醒与教育
steps.label_en: Send only consented learning or service updates

steps.label_zh: 留存、满意度和退订监控
steps.label_en: Review retention, opt-outs and deletion requests

guardrails_zh: 不把 AI 回复伪装成人类承诺
recipes.stop_condition_zh: 任何真实客户信息需要独立认证与权限审查
recipes.stop_condition_en: Real customer data needs separately reviewed authentication and authorization
guardrails_en: Do not impersonate a human or promise outcomes

recipes.goal_zh: 构造成本与样本外约束下的量化研究方案
recipes.goal_en: Design an out-of-sample, cost-aware finance research baseline
inputs_zh: 已获使用权的历史行情数据说明
冻结的预测目标与时间分割
outputs_zh: 样本外指标与成本敏感性记录
acceptance_zh: 绝不发送模拟盘或实盘订单
acceptance_en: Do not send demo or live brokerage orders

steps.label_zh: 冻结研究假设与可追溯行情
steps.label_en: Freeze hypothesis and licensed market-data provenance

steps.label_zh: 检验泄漏、偏差和条件预测
steps.label_en: Check data leakage and selection bias

steps.label_zh: 真实交易成本模拟
steps.label_en: Model realistic spreads, slippage and costs

steps.label_zh: 样本外和模拟盘前瞻审查
steps.label_en: Run chronological OOS and paper-only analysis

steps.label_zh: 独立审批风险参数和部署
steps.label_en: Independently review risk policy before deployment

guardrails_zh: 禁止直接授予 AI 实盘下单权限
实盘前独立合法性与风险审查
recipes.stop_condition_zh: 严格研究用途，不连接账户、无需收益承诺
recipes.stop_condition_en: Research only; no brokerage access or return guarantees
guardrails_en: Do not grant AI live-order permissions
Require separate legal, security and risk approval before live execution

recipes.goal_zh: 从授权课程素材到可检查的练习反馈
recipes.goal_en: Build an auditable learning exercise from licensed materials
inputs_zh: 授权课程讲义或公开示例材料
不含学生信息的合成问答
inputs_en: Licensed lesson notes or public example content
outputs_zh: 带引用的结构化课程片段
有评分依据的练习和复盘记录
acceptance_zh: 每条题解可以返回原文证据
不展示无依据的能力或分数承诺
acceptance_en: Each explanation links back to source evidence

steps.label_zh: 课程版权和使用授权
steps.label_en: Verify curriculum and content rights

steps.label_zh: 文档结构化并保存引用
steps.label_en: Structure lesson sources with traceable citations

steps.label_zh: 题目、案例、可视化练习
steps.label_en: Build exercises, cases and visual practice

steps.label_zh: 语音互动及错误诊断
steps.label_en: Review speech interactions and mistakes

steps.label_zh: 学习前后测与质量抽检
steps.label_en: Evaluate learning outcomes and sample quality

guardrails_zh: 避免无依据的成绩承诺
recipes.stop_condition_zh: 教学内容与学生隐私必须分别审查
recipes.stop_condition_en: Review teaching content rights and learner privacy separately
guardrails_en: Verify course, media and illustration rights
Avoid ungrounded score or improvement promises
